name: Vintius

attributes.attribute: matched by Romans with the twin god Pollux
name that points to the wind and honor from sailors

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Vintius is a Continental Celtic god. The Romans equated him with their twin god Pollux, a rare pairing that explains little about him. His name seems to signal the wind, and Celtic sailors gave him honor.

okr.objective: Present Vintius as a Continental Celtic god linked to the wind.
key_results: The Romans equated Vintius with Pollux.
His name appears to refer to wind.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
